Maya (People Ops): All-hands in ~20m. Thread for last-minute swaps, captions, and recording fallback. Green room at conf A at 14:10.
Carlos (AV): Bringing main rig + backup laptop. Will test live captions (Otter) and local VTT fallback. If YouTube ingest fails we'll use internal stream.
Jun (Eng): For the demo stream I recommend keyint=48, bitrate cap 4.5Mbps, and NVENC encoder if CPU > 60%.
Priya (Product): Can we move "Billing roadmap" after "Scale improvements"? That keeps the demo momentum.
Sam (CEO): OK. Keep Q&A to 20-25m. I'll monitor the questions doc and this thread.
Rory (Legal): Quick flag: any customer screenshots need approval. Mark slides "CUSTOMER CONTENT" and send to legal-review@redwood.ai.
Carlos (AV): CaptionBot live check: latency ~2s. If captions drop below confidence 0.6 we'll switch to local VTT. Also external SSD is mounted for local recording: /mnt/ssd/all-hands-1792009876.mp4
CaptionBot: Captions enabled  confidence 0.92.
Jun (Eng): If OBS drops frames, reduce canvas to 720p and set Max B-frames to 0. Also use `ps aux | grep ffmpeg` to kill duplicate ffmpeg if needed.
Maya (People Ops): Reminder: presenters please join green room 10m before your slot for mic check. Wired headset recommended.
Priya (Product): Post-meeting: product will collect top 3 roadmap Qs and assign owners within 48h.
Carlos (AV): Backup plan: 1) local SSD recording, 2) SRT ingest, 3) internal-only stream. I'll post `:warning: fallback active` if we flip.
Maya (People Ops): Two-minute warning will be posted here. Follow-ups and notes posted in #all-hands after meeting. Good luck everyone! :sparkles:
